name: CPDDF-based SI3DR
definition: A method that predicts a camera and latent shape from an image, then uses a Conditional PDDF (CPDDF) to render geometry from any viewpoint.
summary: CPDDF-based SI3DR is a single-image 3D reconstruction method that implicitly represents shape as a differentiable field conditioned on a latent code, enabling view-consistent rendering and explicit sampling.
